'''Yosuke Kamide''' (1943–2021) was a Japanese physicist. He co-founded the Asia Oceania Geosciences Society and served as vice-president of the [[International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy]] from 2003 to 2007. He was a fellow of the [[American Geophysical Union]] and the Japan Geoscience Union. He won a [[Price Medal]] from the [[Royal Astronomical Society]]. He taught at [[Nagoya University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Obituary: Prof. Yosuke Kamide (1943-2021) |url=https://www.isee.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/news/2021/20211220-2.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=ISEE Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research, Nagoya University |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Lane |first=J. |date=2003-04-01 |title=New medal winners and Associates |url=https://academic.oup.com/astrogeo/article-lookup/doi/10.1093/astrog/44.2.2.5-c |journal=Astronomy & Geophysics |language=en |volume=44 |issue=2 |pages=2.5–c–2.5 |doi=10.1093/astrog/44.2.2.5-c |issn=1366-8781|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
